name: Seeing Yourself
overview: Scripture reveals that seeing yourself rightly begins with humility, as pride leads to conflict and downfall, while wisdom comes through being well advised (Proverbs 13:10; 16:18). God’s plans for us are rooted in peace and hope, assuring us of a purposeful future (Jeremiah 29:11). True self-understanding is found in abiding in Jesus’ word, which brings freedom through knowing the truth and receiving eternal life by faith in Him (John 3:16; 8:31-32).
